bookingOpens: Online through Zenchef on the restaurant's website. Tables are released a month at a time, well ahead: December 2026 opened on 1 September 2026 at 8am. A booking is only confirmed once the confirmation email arrives.

bookingWindow.note: Released a month at a time; December 2026 opened on 1 September 2026 at 8am.

cancellation: Card details are needed to hold the table. Nothing is charged unless the booking is cancelled within 72 hours of the meal or nobody turns up.
groups: Tables of more than eight are by special request. Wheelchair access for parties of up to seven, if the restaurant is told in advance.
